name: Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai -Dreaming Sheep-
original_name: 大図書館の羊飼い -Dreaming Sheep-
source:
This is the fandisk to Daitoshokan no Hitsujikai. “The book club is eternal!!” Everyone ignored Kana; it’s another normal day at the book club. They still joke around and do random tasks. The only difference is that Kyoutarou has a girlfriend and at least to him, they have a pure relationship even if the rest of the members call them a lovey-dovey couple. It’s become much more fun than before.

[From [url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
这是《大图书馆的牧羊人》的Fan Disc。“读书社是永恒的！！”没有人在听奏奈说话，读书社又是平常的一天。他们仍然开着玩笑、做着随意的任务。唯一的不同是京太郎有了女朋友，至少在他看来，即使其他成员都叫他们甜蜜情侣，他们的关系是纯洁的。比以前有趣多了。

[来自[url=http://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2014/03/01/march-2014-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
